title: Deaths on record: pedestrians killed in Gurugram where a public record states what the road lacked
licence: CC BY 4.0 for this compilation; each source is cited and remains its publisher's
rules: A date, and a place as close as the record allows: to about 100 m where a landmark is named, otherwise the named road and village, marked approximate. The point is rounded to four decimals.

The person's age band and what they were doing, as reported. A minor's name only where the family has spoken publicly; never a photograph of the victim. Adults are not named either unless the family asks.

An infrastructure fact stated by the record itself (no footpath, walking on the carriageway, no crossing, open drain or manhole, a cable on a waterlogged footpath, a dark stretch), quoted, never inferred.
An official record (a tribunal award, a court or commission order, an FIR reported by the police, a departmental inquiry), or two independent press reports.
Other reported factors (speed, drink, a fleeing driver) are recorded as reported; no blame is added. The entry says what the road lacked, not who was at fault.
Where a case is before a court or tribunal, the entry says so and quotes nothing beyond the record. Where reports disagree on what happened, the case stays out.

fields.doing: as reported, e.g. walking home from school
fields.how: as reported, e.g. was hit by a truck on the carriageway
fields.fact: the infrastructure fact, quoted from the source
fields.fact_source: index into sources of the quote
fields.name: only where the family has spoken publicly
fields.road: id in roads.json when within 60 m
fields.count: deaths in this entry when one incident killed more than one person (default 1)

pending: 21 Sep 2025, Golf Course Road outside La Lagune, Sector 54: a woman crossing the road was killed by a speeding car. The reports state the crossing, not what the road lacked at that point; the police's own statement that Golf Course Road has no foot overbridges is from a separate report. Enters when a record ties the two.

27 Oct 2025, Dinokri village, Pataudi: a six-year-old crossing the road with her father to board the school bus was hit by a tractor and then by the bus. The reports do not state what the road lacked at the pick-up point.

9 Oct 2026, Hero Honda Chowk: a woman crossing from the bus stop towards Subhash Chowk on her way to work was hit from behind by a crane. The reports state the crossing, not the absence of a crossing facility.

11 Oct 2026, NH-48 before Manesar bus stand: a 24-year-old woman crossing the highway after getting off a bus was killed in a hit-and-run. The reports do not state what the highway lacked at that point.
9 Jul 2025, Sispal Vihar Gate 2, Sector 49: a 27-year-old fell into an open sewer during waterlogging. Reports disagree on whether he was on foot or in his vehicle.
9 Jul 2025, Sector 18 near Genpact Chowk: a 26-year-old delivery worker on foot was electrocuted beside a submerged pole. Reports differ on the place and on what he touched.
11 Oct 2026, pavement near Airia Mall, Sohna Road: a 63-year-old woman sleeping on the footpath was killed when a car mounted the pavement. The footpath was present; she was not walking.
About 11 Feb 2026, Ullawas Road, Sector 61: a 42-year-old woman on the footpath was killed when a garbage pick-up veered off the road. One report only so far.
